index.summary: Transparent proxy and drop-in shim mode (dogdouclix.exe) with companion configuration loading (.clix.json/.clix.ini), PATH penetration target resolution, and zero-caller-awareness argument pass-through.

product.objective: Implement Transparent Proxy and Drop-in Shim mode in dogdouclix.exe, enabling seamless execution interception where callers invoke dogdouclix as a drop-in binary (via rename, symlink, or prior PATH entry), with automatic companion configuration loading (.clix.json/.clix.ini), PATH penetration target resolution, and 100% transparent argument pass-through without --clix-* prefixes.

index.summary: Companion configuration parser for JSON and INI formats defining target paths and context transformation rules.

deliverable.description: Config parsing subsystem for .clix.json and .clix.ini companion files.

index.summary: Target resolution engine supporting companion configs, environment variables, and PATH penetration.

deliverable.description: Resolution logic for locating target binaries without recursion.

index.summary: Transparent shim execution workflow forwarding all arguments after argv[0] directly to target.
Integration test suite for transparent proxying, config loading, and PATH penetration.

deliverable.description: Automated regression and integration test harness.

included.item: Lightweight JSON/INI parser for target path, environment mutations, working directory, and user context.
PATH penetration resolution: finding the next binary with same name in downstream PATH directories.
Transparent argument forwarding: forwarding all arguments after argv[0] to target with 100% fidelity.
Dual mode support: automatic fallback to explicit mode when invoked directly as dogdouclix.exe.

excluded.item: Dynamic DLL injection or API hooking into target memory.

requirement.statement: dogdouclix must parse companion JSON and INI configuration files defining target executable paths, environment variable mutations, and user security contexts.
requirement.rationale: Enables declarative, zero-caller-code context injection and target binding.

requirement.statement: dogdouclix must resolve the target executable path via companion config, environment variable (DOGDOUCLIX_TARGET), or PATH penetration when invoked as a renamed or symlinked shim.
requirement.rationale: Drop-in shims placed earlier in PATH must locate the authentic downstream binary without recursion.

index.summary: Transparent argument pass-through in shim mode.

requirement.statement: When operating in transparent proxy mode, dogdouclix must forward all command-line arguments after argv[0] directly to the resolved target without caller awareness.
requirement.rationale: Drop-in compatibility requires complete transparency to parent shells and toolchains.

acceptance.criterion: Companion config files (.clix.json / .clix.ini) are accurately parsed and applied to context transformations.
When shim is renamed to a target binary in a high-priority PATH directory, it successfully finds and executes the real binary in downstream PATH directories without infinite self-recursion.
All arguments passed to shim (including quotes, flags, and subcommands) are forwarded to the real target with exact fidelity.
